{{Quote|It is the findsman's way to see the truth, Captain. To find the signs that hide amongst the ordinary.|Yuun|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''findsmen''' (singular: '''findsman''') were a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]&mdash;though the findsmen themselves claimed that their abilities did not stem from [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>&mdash;religious tradition of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] unique to the [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The findsmen [[Gand religion|worshiped]] the enshrouding mists of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gand (planet)/Legends|Gand]], divining omens and signs in order to locate their prey.<ref name="GG3:TESB" /> Becoming a findsman sometimes was granted to a Gand during a ''[[janwuine-jika]]''. Findsmen could locate people, things, places, and even events by auguring signs sent to them during their mystical rituals that could take at least three hours to complete.<ref name="GG3:TESB,2">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref> Findsmen were legendary figures in Gand society, and the title had a bit of prestige outside of Gand society as well.

[[File:Venlyss_Pnorr.png|thumb|left|150px|[[Venlyss Pnorr]]]]
Certain findsmen sects would instruct their apprentices to bathe in specific chemicals, or even subject them to genetic manipulation, which would cause knob-like growths to appear on portions of their [[exoskeleton]]s. These serrated growths, usually located on the [[Limb/Legends|arms]] and legs and sometimes four to five [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]] in length,<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> would then be used as weapons in hand-to-hand combat.<ref name="EGtAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref><ref name="NEGtAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>

The findsmen had developed a form of [[Gand martial arts|martial arts]] centuries before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] that made use of the Gand biology. The tenets of the form were not understood, though a few moves were described: "Piercing Touch" and "Striking Mist." "Piercing Touch" was a powerful punch that could penetrate [[Bone/Legends|bone]], [[Chitin/Legends|chitin]], and various [[Armor/Legends|armors]].<ref name="AE" /> [[Ooryl Qrygg]] demonstrated this move on [[Talasea]], when he punched a hole through [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] armor.<ref name="X-W:RS">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref> "Striking Mist" allowed the attacking Gand to sneak in close to their opponent so that the Gand's hits could not be parried or dodged.<ref name="AE" />

Outsiders often saw the findsman as a bizarre religious sect devoted to hunting, while the Gand themselves considered findsmen to be on the "path to truth."<ref name="SaV">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref>

Findsmen were hired as security [[Advisor/Legends|advisors]], [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]], bounty hunters, investigators, and even [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]]. The training of a findsman required devotion and study, and leaving the tradition would often be a [[Death/Legends|death]] sentence for the wayward findsman. Members of that findsman's sect, if they were to learn of their initiate's stray from the path, were likely to deem that findsman a rogue and kill them on sight.<ref name="AA">''[[Alien Anthology]]''</ref>

In [[3951 BBY]] a group of nearly a hundred Gand bounty hunters left to temporarily settle on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in order to help find [[Meetra Surik]] at the request of [[G0-T0]]. Among their number were several findsmen, most of whom were killed by Surik and her party in the ensuing conflict.

Prior to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the findsman tradition had started to die out.<ref name="SWCE">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> During the Galactic Civil War, the bounty hunter [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]] and the pilot Ooryl Qrygg were findsmen, two of the few to leave their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].
